title: The Relationship Between Morbid Obesity and Carotid Artery Stenosis
brief_summary: The correlation between metabolic syndrome and carotid artery stenosis is well established. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the relationship between morbid obesity and carotid artery stenosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Candidates for first bariatric surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smokers or past smokers
* Patients who are post carotid artery intervention
